title: Jonah and the Undertow
author: Wendell Almeida
blurb: Jonah Joubert, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
